verdicts.evidence: lines 185, 187-200, 202-215, 218-237: Try again, Save team name, Send invite, Remove and Invite back all have handlers that call the api and re-render
line 6: the page title hardcodes 'Northwind Studio' and no code sets document.title, so the tab keeps the old name after a rename (line 193). All in-page values come from api.getTeam (lines 150-172)
lines 42-84: one screen, no step depends on an earlier step or screen
lines 45-76: two separate forms of one and two inputs, no multi-step task and no free text longer than a line
lines 43-83: settings screen with four equal tasks (rename, members, invite, notifications), no single dominant frequent task
lines 43-83: sections are Team name, Members, Invite a member, Email notifications, each matching a brief task; no stat cards or extra panels
line 49 is the only button with class primary; Send invite (line 75), Try again (line 39), Remove (line 159) and Invite back (line 227) are plain
line 159: Remove is a plain type=button in its own Actions column, outside any form so Enter does not trigger it, and not primary styled

line 159: owner row shows text 'The owner cannot be removed' instead of a button; line 155 owner role is text. Selects and checkboxes are disabled only during their own request (lines 243-246, 250-253)
no title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the file
lines 35-83, 136-141: visible text is headings, labels, hints and messages about the team; nothing about implementation, mock data or the request
line 73 role hint sits at the role select and informs member vs admin; line 81 'Each change is saved as you make it' sits at the checkboxes; line 159 owner note sits where Remove would be
lines 73, 81: remaining guidance is one short line at the control it concerns; no 'this page lets you' narration. Line 63 empty text points to the invite form in one line
lines 44 and 46: heading 'Team name' is immediately followed by a label 'Team name', the same words said twice for one field
lines 35-83, 136-141, 195, 212, 227: no greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks; text states facts and names actions
lines 39, 49, 75, 159, 227: 'Try again', 'Save team name', 'Send invite', 'Remove <name>', 'Invite <name> back' all start with a verb and name the object
lines 127-128: role and notification keys are mapped to Owner/Admin/Member and plain labels; line 133 null last active shows 'Not yet signed in'; no ids or codes shown
lines 136-141: every error code is turned into a sentence with a next step; raw e.message is never shown. Line 38 load error names the problem and says try again
lines 38, 137-140, 234, 245, 252: wording is 'could not be loaded', 'was not saved', 'was not removed'; no invalid, failed, oops, capitals or exclamation marks
lines 63, 151: with zero members the view shows 'No one is on this team yet. Invite the first member below.' and the invite form follows directly (lines 66-77)
lines 37-40, 182: a failed load shows its own panel with Try again; lines 63, 151: an empty team shows a different message pointing to invite. There is no filter
lines 181-183 load failure shows panel and retry; lines 196-198, 213, 234, 245, 252: each failed save states it in place, keeps the typed value or restores the control, and the action can be repeated
line 176 'Loading team settings...' shown at once; lines 143-148 buttons switch to Saving/Sending/Removing labels; lines 243, 250 controls disable with a status line. Calls last at most 1.5 seconds
lines 42, 175-180: #content, which holds the empty text, stays hidden until getTeam resolves; only the loading line is visible meanwhile
lines 23, 25: cells use overflow-wrap anywhere inside an overflow-x wrapper; line 26 actions wrap; line 133 missing lastActive renders 'Not yet signed in'; line 132 values are escaped

lines 69-70: the only format-bound field is labelled 'Email address' with type=email, so the expected format is stated in the label before typing
lines 46-47, 69-74: team name and email are both required and the role select always has a value; there are no optional fields
lines 187-190, 202-206: validation runs only in the submit handlers, there are no input or keyup listeners; the message is replaced on the next successful submit (lines 194-195, 211-212)
lines 47-48, 70-71: each message paragraph sits directly under its input; line 20 prefixes errors with the text 'Problem: ' in addition to the red colour
lines 190, 196-198: rename never clears the field on error; lines 205, 213: invite keeps the typed email on failure and clears it only on success (line 211)

lines 49, 75: submit buttons are never disabled; lines 190, 206: submitting empty or malformed input shows what to enter and focuses the field
lines 143-148: busy() returns early if the button already has aria-busy, and swaps the label to Saving.../Sending invite... until the call settles
lines 146, 176, 243, 250: buttons change label synchronously on click, retry shows the loading line, and selects and checkboxes disable with a status line before the await
line 195 'Team name saved.'; lines 209-212 new row plus message; lines 225-227 row removed plus message; lines 244, 251 status text; failures stated at lines 197, 213, 234, 245, 252
